purpose: Report information or identify a typical quality.
keywords: Plain clause + らしい; noun + らしい.
Apparently a new shop will open next week.
Today’s weather is typical of spring.
Apparently Ms. Tanaka is off today.
Share information or express your own impression
formation: Plain clause + らしい; noun + らしい.
restrictions: Reported inference and typicality are distinct uses.
mistake: Do not insert だ immediately after a noun before らしい.
